plugin.name: enne_newlines2spaces
plugin.author: enne
plugin.purpose: type nl2s to convert clipboard content from newlines to spaces, and escape semicolons

muclient.script: function process(name, line, val) local tmp=GetClipboard() -- utils.inputbox("", "text") tmp=Replace(tmp, "\r\n", " ", true) tmp=Replace(tmp, "\r", " ", true) tmp=Replace(tmp, "\n", " ", true) tmp=Replace(tmp, ";", ";;", true) if val[1]~=nil and val[1]=="color" then tmp=Replace(tmp, "@", "@@", true) end-- if SetClipboard(tmp) Note("Done!") end-- func
